summary: Open-source desktop ChatGPT alternative that downloads and runs AI models on your own computer, with optional cloud models.

heroCommands.command: Get the installer for Windows, macOS or Linux from jan.ai or GitHub Releases

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Jan is a desktop app for chatting with AI models. You can download open models such as Llama, Gemma and Qwen from Hugging Face and run them locally, or connect cloud models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq and others, all in one app.
sixtySeconds.problem: Many people want ChatGPT-style help without sending everything to the cloud. Jan gives full control and privacy by running models on your machine when you want it to.
whoFor: Privacy-minded people who want local AI
Beginners who prefer an app over the command line
Developers who need a local OpenAI-compatible API
Users who mix local and cloud models
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for an easy, open-source app that runs models locally, exposes an OpenAI-compatible server at localhost:1337 and supports MCP.
requirements: macOS 13.6+, Windows 10+ or a common Linux distribution
Enough RAM for your model size (8GB for 3B, 16GB for 7B, 32GB for 13B on macOS)

overview: Install the app from jan.ai, GitHub Releases, the Microsoft Store or Flathub. Downloads are available for Windows, macOS (universal), Linux deb, AppImage and Arm64.

Features include local models from Hugging Face, cloud integrations, custom assistants, a local OpenAI-compatible API server at localhost:1337 for other apps, and Model Context Protocol support for agent capabilities.

System requirements from the README: macOS 13.6+ (8GB RAM for 3B models, 16GB for 7B, 32GB for 13B), Windows 10+ with GPU support for NVIDIA, AMD or Intel Arc, and most Linux distributions with GPU acceleration. The project is Apache 2.0 licensed.
